title: PotaTOE QOL
description: A QOL modpack that aims to improve day to day Minecraft.
body:
# PotaTOE Modpack

This modpack help supplement Minecraft by adding quality features with good performance. PotaTOE is also built to be customizable with many shaders pre-downloaded and with the Resourcify mod allows you to add and remove resource, data, and shader packs as well as easily download worlds to play in! We hope you enjoy the PotaTOE experience!
